description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Mitotic Slime, adding {C}{C}.
When Mitotic Slime dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger,
Resolve the Mitotic Slime trigger, creating two 2/2 Ooze creature tokens.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Ooze, adding {C}{C}.
When the Ooze dies, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Ooze creature tokens.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Mitotic Slime from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.
